name: rail-highway-pay
about: A sound ad: a white tractor and van on a prairie highway at dusk, the pay below it. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-highway-pay`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: the subject is clear, the plate is the kit's green, the headline over the truck

subject_legible.reason: A crisp white semi-truck and trailer dominates the frame against a vivid sunset sky, instantly readable as a tractor-trailer at a glance.

words_match_picture.reason: The headline touts per-mile OTR pay and the picture shows an OTR tractor-trailer rolling down an open highway — a direct, cohesive match.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The bold white headline commands the lower half, the outlined 'Apply Today' button sits clearly beneath it, and the truck photo above doesn't compete with the text.

looks_like_kit.reason: The deep forest-green (#0B3D2E) appears in the bottom bar and the button outline, and white is used throughout, fully matching the two supplied brand colours; no logo is present but none was provided.
